target_customer: Lithium-ion battery makers needing graphite anode material
problem: Battery-grade graphite comes largely from mining or fossil-derived synthetic processes; Maple Materials aims to make it from CO2 by electrolysis at roughly one third the cost.
business_model: Materials manufacturing, sale of graphite anode material

founders.name: Drew Reid
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as the only founder; Greentown Labs lists him as founder and CEO. Education and prior employers not found.

technical_complexity.rationale: Molten carbonate electrolysis to turn CO2 into battery-grade graphite is research-grade chemistry and process engineering that needed to be proven at scale.

defensibility.rationale: A patented process (per search summaries) is hard to replicate, though unproven at commercial scale.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent response found; no acquisition or shutdown news found.

market_need_then: Graphite is the dominant lithium-ion anode material and the YC description argues a one third cost opportunity with a carbon negative potential; no dated independent demand source was opened.

identity.voice_and_tone: Technical and claim-led: 'We turn CO2 into battery-grade graphite and oxygen'

brand_strength.rationale: Little public brand presence found; a member of Greentown Labs but no press about the brand.

outcome_analysis: Maple Materials is listed as active with a team of 6 and is a Greentown Labs member. No press releases, acquisition, shutdown or credible funding record were found, so its progress from the lab process toward commercial graphite supply is unknown. Aggregators suggest grants from NSF and the Department of Energy, but these are unverified.
notes: Funding is unverified aggregator data: one shows $2.29M including a $150K pre-seed and a $914K grant, a later version $8.45M with a $6.16M round of unknown series, DOE $1M and NSF grants of $914K and $225K; Caplight says $8.74M; Startup-Seeker says $6.2M. None confirmed by a company or press source, so no rounds are recorded. Greentown Labs shows founded 2013; YC gives no founding year, so founded_year is null. The company website returned 404 so the site may be dead or moved. Competitor list left empty: searches found only silicon anode firms (Sila, Group14) and graphite suppliers with no 2018 to 2019 dated source for a CO2 to graphite rival.
